messages:
Maya Chen: heads-up — main CI turned red right after merge from @liam. pipeline: https://ci.redwood.company/2400001234 :rotating_light:
DeployBot: Pipeline 2400001234 - FAILED in step `db-migrations` (exit 1). Commit: 7f3a9b2 (liam@redwood)
Liam Ortiz: ugh sorry, which migration step?
Maya Chen: error snippet:
```sql
ERROR:  relation "users_ghost" already exists
DETAIL:  duplicate creation of ghost table in migration 20260310_add_ghost.sql
``` 
Maya Chen: it looks like a duplicate ghost schema creation; tests after that pass but migration fails.
Kai Patel: can we rerun just the db job? @DeployBot restart job db-migrations for pipeline 2400001234
DeployBot: Restart queued: db-migrations (job 58). ETA ~2m
Maya Chen: rerun started
DeployBot: db-migrations - FAILED again. same error. 
DevOps Sherpa: if it's deterministic we should bisect the merge range. who merged last? commit says liam.
Liam Ortiz: that was my conversion PR for migrations batching. I'll look now, feel bad. I'll try to patch the migration to noop if table exists.
Maya Chen: CI is blocking main so need quick plan: revert PR or hotfix in migration wrapper? preferences?
Kai Patel: revert is fastest. open a revert PR and we can unbreak main in ~10m.
Liam Ortiz: ok pushing revert now. will follow up with a patch PR to make migration idempotent.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: no production impact detected. Keep incident channel updated if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
Maya Chen: thanks all — assigning followups: liam will open patch PR; maya will monitor pipeline and merge revert once green.
Liam Ortiz: opened revert: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2412 reverting 7f3a9b2
Maya Chen: rerunning full pipeline on revert branch.
DeployBot: Pipeline 2400001291 (revert PR) - SUCCESS
Maya Chen: revert merged, main CI passing again. marking this done, will post postmortem in eng-infra later.
